items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: We all used to play at Woodman Hall on a Saturday night.

ctx.x: Willie Guitars? Yeah, Willie Guitars. And Nappy? Nappy Lamar and, uh, uh, Aleister Boucher. We all used to play at Woodman Hall on a Saturday night. That was a big deal. I think we got about three dollars and a ham sandwich to play on it.
Oh, who was the piano player in that picture? Uh, Nappy's brother or something? Brother, yeah.
